items.html: And indeed, the outer of the two parts of the Yod of the Milui [filling] of the first Hey, as above, these descended within the inner of the ten lower parts of this Vav. And the inner of the two aforementioned parts of the Yod descend within the inner of the three upper parts of this Vav, all of which total thirteen in Gematria. And it is known that there are thirteen inner and thirteen outer. And indeed, the thirteen inner became a discernment of outer to the discernment of the two last parts of the Milui of the Yod of the first Hey, with respect to both their outer and their inner, in the manner above.
